content.title: Pittsburgh Parade Day Dash
content.text: Overview Lace up your sneakers, put on your green, and get ready to MOVE! P3R invites you to join us for the second annual Pittsburgh Parade Day Dash Presented by GNC, a vibrant and family-friendly celebration happening on March 14, just before the start of Pittsburgh’s iconic America’s Grand St. Patrick’s Day Event! This event will feature a 5K and a 1-Mile Family Fun Run/Walk following a scenic route through Pittsburgh. Participants will receive a limited edition hoodie, finisher medal, and bib included in their registration for both timed events. Can’t make it to the Steel City on Parade Day, but still want to participate and get your hands on these finisher items? We are offering a virtual registration option to show off your Parade Day pride from anywhere! Costume Contest Wear your best St. Patrick's Day outfit during the race and head to the costume contest photo booth after your cross the finish line in the finish line chute. A panel of judges will determine the winning costumes and the winners will receive a GNC gift card! Brooks Lucky Stride After you cross the finish line, look out for the Brooks Lucky Stride scratch off cards. If you scratch the card and win a prize, head to the Brooks tent in the finish line chute to claim it. Prizes include Brooks shoes, hats, arm sleeves, socks, shirts and discounts on future race registrations!
